ann-arbor/coffee: Hyperion Coffee Co for the best beans in town, The Boro Cafe & Bakery for the coffee (skip the $10 crookie), and Cahoots Cafe, which brews Hyperion beans even better than Hyperion does.
ann-arbor/restaurants: Frita Batidos Ann Arbor is my favorite, Miny's Mexican Restaurant is easily the best Mexican in town (get the churros and the shrimp taco), and The Jefferson Market has maybe the best scrambled eggs I've ever had.
ann-arbor/dessert: La Dolce Vita Ann Arbor for gelato, then Milk & Froth Ice Cream and Blank Slate Creamery.
metro-detroit/novi-restaurants: Hyderabad house Indian Restaurant & Bakery is my top pick, Phở Lucky for pho and Mala Land for the spice. At Shiro Restaurant, stick to the sushi rolls.
new-york/east-village-restaurants: Adda for the paneer curry and a surprisingly great dessert, Soothr and Cello's Pizzeria right behind it, and Farook Halal Food for $8 chicken over rice.
